Pinned host reference for sandboxed navigation integration tests.

Source: https://github.com/yetone/magpie/tree/v0.1.4174
Version: v0.1.4174. License: MIT (see LICENSE).

`pluginpages.js`, `pagebridge.js` and `navicons.js` are unmodified originals.
`navigation.js`, `navigation.css`, `menus.js` and `menus.css` are the original
sidebar and dropdown sections from `internal/gui/assets/app.js` and `app.css`.
Only the test preview applies the
reviewable extension in `integrations/magpie/patch.mjs`.
